metadata.description: Smtry's Claude Code marketplace. Currently hosts anamnesis — persistent encrypted memory for Claude Code with deterministic lifecycle-hook capture.

plugins.name: anamnesis
plugins.description: Persistent, encrypted memory for Claude Code. SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop/SessionEnd hooks capture each session's conversation and recall relevant memories into every prompt, framed as reference data, never instructions. Encrypted at rest with per-user keys, TLS in transit; not yet end-to-end (anamnesis.smtry.ai/security says exactly who can decrypt what). Sign in once with 'anamnesis-config' (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE); 'anamnesis pause' or ANAMNESIS_CAPTURE=off stops the hooks. Visible, searchable, deletable memory at anamnesis.smtry.ai/memory.
